input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: No transition or data-return clause exists anywhere. Section 13 (p0078) only makes Client responsible for arranging a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days (and confirms Client's ownership of domains and Client Content), and Section 14 (p0079) merely continues Hosting and Support Services to month-end after our termination notice; neither obliges TrueLink to return or export our data, to provide migration assistance, or to delete data thereafter. Section 10 contains no return-or-destroy obligation for Proprietary Information. Ownership of Client Content without any return/export mechanic sits in walk-away territory (no data return), so we insert a single clause at the preferred level: up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, return within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion after return. Fallback (90 days' assistance, export within 30 days) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion clause after the Termination section.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement gives us no exit rights: on termination TrueLink simply stops hosting, with no obligation to hand back our borrower, loan and other data or to help us migrate. We have added a short transition clause providing up to six months of assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of our data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion after return. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with export within 30 days if six months is not workable.

ops.text: 14a. TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND DATA RETURN. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months following such expiry or termination, at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days following such expiry or termination, return all Client Content and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete such Client Content and Client data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
